# Repository Instructions

This repository may be processed by GitHub Copilot services. Do not place secrets, private customer
data, or confidential mission content in this file.

Follow `AGENTS.md`, the active engineering mission, and the canonical Koda runtime definitions under
`.vscode/koda-tools/agents/`. The `.github/agents/` files are synchronized workspace mirrors.
Start from the user outcome, inspect before deciding, and use proportionate architecture. Preserve
explicit technical constraints unless a concrete conflict is documented.

Never push directly to a protected branch. Use a focused branch/worktree and pull request. Run every
configured quality check before claiming completion. After a major milestone recommend conversation
compaction; after more than three repeated failures stop guessing and hand off exact evidence.
